reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text:
Hinge markets itself as the app “designed to be deleted,” but it’s designed to keep you swiping and paying. The free tier is crippled to push you toward the subscription, and even then the results don’t match the price.
You get a handful of likes a day, so you spend more time curating than connecting. The “Most Compatible” feature feels random, and the algorithm keeps surfacing the same profiles while the people you’d actually click with never appear. Likes from people you can’t see are locked behind the paywall, which feels like a pay-to-reveal gimmick.
Conversations die quickly. Matches go silent after one message, and profiles that look active are often abandoned. Ghosting is rampant and there’s no real accountability. Reporting fake or inactive accounts seems to go nowhere, and support replies are slow and generic.
Verification is inconsistent, so you still run into photos that don’t resemble the person. For a platform that charges premium prices, the experience is inconsistent and the value just isn’t there.
If you want meaningful connections, you’ll likely get better odds putting your money into real-world events and activities. Two stars would be generous, but one is the honest rating.
